note: The two colourings look the same to me.
Practically the same; at most tiny differences in the red shading on the figure's back.
Colouring 2 loses the greens of the right-hand foliage to olive and grey and adds a greyish-pink patch on the figure's back.
Colouring 2 drains the pink clouds to purple with red streaks and puts blocky grey-yellow cells around the sun.
Colouring 1 covers the right lens with flat grey blocks, losing the red glasses rim and the face colour.
Colouring 2 turns the path into blocky grey with pale yellow cells and a pink cell, and loses the green grass at the edges; colouring 1's path is too pink but smooth.
Colouring 1 drains the greens to olive and breaks the sky into patchy grey and pastel blocks.
Colouring 1 loses the dragon's green and puts stray magenta patches on the warriors.
Colouring 2's path is drained grey with blocky pale-yellow cells and a pink cell; colouring 1's pink path reads smoother though too pink.
